correctness.rationale: The known cycle-independence suspension recurrence gives Ind(C11) homotopy S^3; C11 prime rotation acts freely because a nontrivial invariant supporting face would contain all vertices. The Fourier map F=(sum_j x_j omega^(4j),sum_j x_j omega^(5j)) transforms by weights (4,5). On each maximal independent five-face a rotated real linear separator is strictly positive, so normalized F is globally defined. The supplied integral 28-tetrahedron cycle is boundaryless; the degree at ray (2,3,5,7) has exactly one positive cone meeting simplex (0,3,7,9) with coefficient+1 and determinant negative, degree -1. The original verifier uses rigorous rational trigonometric enclosures; an independent high-precision determinant and integer boundary check recovered the same unique signed crossing and |critical determinant|~0.48545. S^3 degree -1 is a homotopy equivalence; descent between free C11 quotients is a weak equivalence of CW spaces. Rescaling generator 4^(-1)=3 gives lens weights (1,4). High-precision numerics are only corroboration, not the source rational sign proof.
residual_risks: Degree certificate verifies an explicit integer fundamental cycle only; source uses rational error bounds to pass from finite approximations to true trig coefficients.
Equivariant map is asserted a homotopy equivalence, not a homeomorphism or PL identification.
